summary: Source-identified complete internal carotid artery occlusion on Doppler ultrasonography.
text:

title: Paraovarian cyst and tubal torsion: ultrasound
summary: Figure 1 shows normal ovary adjacent to paraovarian cyst, thickened tube and a cyst-wall papillary projection in a surgically confirmed isolated tubal torsion case.
text:
Figure 1 shows normal ovary adjacent to paraovarian cyst, thickened tube and a cyst-wall papillary projection in a surgically confirmed isolated tubal torsion case.

Panel A shows a normal ovary adjacent to the paraovarian cyst; panel B shows the thickened tube; panel C shows a papillary projection in the cyst wall. The primary case confirms isolated right fallopian-tube torsion at laparoscopy. The panels come from transabdominal and transrectal examination, without individual section axes supplied.

questions.prompt: What anatomical relationship does panel A show?
questions.answer: A normal ovary adjacent to a cystic mass
questions.explanation: The primary figure caption identifies a normal ovary with a cyst beneath it. The case's isolated right fallopian-tube torsion was subsequently confirmed at laparoscopy.

labels.note: The primary figure caption identifies a normal ovary next to the cyst.
The source red arrows identify a thickened tube.

The source arrow identifies a papillary projection on the cyst wall. The cyst lies in the right broad ligament beside the ovary and is modelled as a fluid-filled finding; the papillary projection itself is not modelled separately.
The figure annotation labels the anechoic bladder lying beside the cyst in panel A.
